notes.title: First Patch for Monster Prom’s Simplified Chinese Localization Out Now!
notes.notes:
As the localization of [b]Monster Prom[/b] in [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] has been a “trial and error” type of task, we are glad to be able to bring you some good news for a change. Based on your feedback, we have provided certain fixes that should ensure smoother playthroughs from now on. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32062743/935c4ec48498d42dcca53e17ac29f035ad592bb8.jpg[/img]


We also found the time to localize the last two content updates - The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/743450/view/3178915594198119055][b]You Do You Valentine’s Day update[/b][/url] and the latest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/743450/view/2188129923769369568][b]Thank You update[/b][/url]. Hope you enjoy them and report back with all the typos you might find. We're still checking feedback from your reports [url=https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=DQSIkWdsW0yxEjajBLZtrQAAAAAAAAAAAAO__SLWKIpURDVBV0FTQjRNVkVGQktBTDFBSlg0REg5VC4u]so send it you have it[/url].

Thanks for loving monsters! 
[b]-Team MonProm[/b]

notes.title: For our 2nd birthday we just want to say “Thank You” with an update on top!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear students, [/b]

Time goes by fast when you’re attending [b]Spooky High[/b]. After 2 full years of monster-loving misadventures, we want to take the time to say [b]“Thank You”[/b] to all the people (and monsters) that helped us get this far. Consider this small but fierce update our birthday gift to you!

[h3][b]What to expect from The “Thank You” Update? [/b][/h3]

Well, as you are probably well aware by now, we don’t want to reveal too much content-wise, because we want you to discover the details on your own. The one thing that can be revealed without fear of spoilers is that this story will be following a mysterious letter.


Thank you for [b]2 amazing years[/b]! See you in the next!
- Team MonProm

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32062743/72572c93aa1c2fc6e68441acd07a4fa6574aaca7.png[/img]


[b]PS:[/b] As you’ve probably already noticed, alongside [b]The ''Thank You'' Update[/b] we also made one additional change to the game.

After many months of careful consideration, we have decided to go with a [b]completely new original soundtrack[/b] for [b]Monster Prom[/b]. Some of you might be hurt by this, but believe us, it hurt us just as much. 

Looking back to the last two years, we realised that we always put the best interest of our wonderful community first, and this situation makes no exception.

Thus, we made a decision to go with a commissioned all new original soundtrack, composed specifically for [b]Monster Prom[/b]. This change will benefit all of our future collaborators and content creators in the long term, making sure that their work is fully protected on all social media & live streaming platforms for many years to come. 

So even if it might take some time to get used to, we hope you’ll end up enjoying it. If this does happen, make sure to visit [url=https://twitter.com/claudimusik]Claudi Martinez[/url] (the composer & producer) on Twitter and show them your love and support! ❤️

notes.title: A Ghost Story - A new spooky update materializes just in time for Halloween
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32062743/e5ecb43a81acb386fc1517273f84c10de9255eae.jpg[/img]

Attention all students, 

Even though we are working hard on [b]Monster Prom’s upcoming sequel[/b], we couldn’t let the most [i]bootiful[/i] time of the year pass us by without treating you to something new. Here’s what’s what with our newest update: [i]A Ghost Story[/i]! 👻


[b]Brand New Plotline[/b] - This Halloween, we’ll explore a tragic tale of romance and dread, played between [i]Winston Montgomery[/i] and the mysterious [i]Esmeralda[/i]. There’s 3 whole new events to look forward to, each leading to what is our [b]longest plotline to date[/b]!

[b]Fresh But Familiar Outfits [/b]- You might have picked up on the hint that there's something going on with [b]The Coven[/b]. Why are the others wearing their outfits? How does that eerie locket fit into all of this? And what does any of this have to do with going to the prom? 

[b]Mod Tool Update[/b] - This [b]Halloween[/b] also marks the public debut of [b]Monster Prom[/b]’s highly anticipated modding tool. We're starting off by providing access to owners of both the base game and [b]Second Term DLC[/b], followed by a full release for all players later this year. There's also a [b]neat little manual[/b] that you can check out right [url=http://monsterprom.pizza/modtoolmanual/]here[/url], right now!

[b]Slashed Prices[/b] - We figured you or your friends might need some extra cash for candy and costumes, so this [b]Steam Halloween Sale[/b] we’re bringing a real bargain for monster romance.

🦇 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/743450/Monster_Prom/]Monster Prom[/url], the base game, has a [b]50% discount[/b]
🧛‍♂️ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/958370/Monster_Prom_Second_Term/]Second Term[/url], the DLC, has a [b]25% discount[/b]


Hope you’ll have a great time uncovering our spooky secrets and, last but not least, thanks for sticking with your favorite boos this [b]Halloween[/b]! 🎃

[b]- Team Monprom [/b] 🐔

notes.notes:

Students of Spooky High,

[b]STEAM SUMMER SALE DEALS[/b] - We’re prepping for all of summer’s late bloomers with some sweet Monprom deals: 
[list]
[*] Monster Prom, the base game, has a 50% discount
[*] Second Term, the DLC, has a 25% discount
[/list]
And that’s not all, similar to the rewards from the Lunar New Year Sale, Steam users who have spent a certain amount can redeem points for a special $5 instant discount coupon (or equivalent currency), emoticons, badges and more. You can find out more about this, once the sale goes live. 

And last but not least, thank you once more for backing monster love. You’re awesome! 
- Team monprom

notes.title: Punch the sun in Monster Prom s new F*ckin Hot update
notes.notes:
Two things made me decide to check out Monster Prom’s free “F*ckin Hot” update this morning, despite not normally having an interest in the dating sim genre. First, the monsters. Second, the multiplayer. It’s a punchy set up: the prom is looming, and you and your friends have got three weeks to woo a 20-something college student. Who may well be a gorgon, or a psychopathic sky-princess.

How on earth does that work? What’s in that new update, other than some summer outfits and the opportunity to help a demon punch the sun? Can I get away with leaving f-bombs in that headline, and can Beautiful Glitch’s monsters melt my cold, non-dating sim-appreciating heart? The answers await below. (more…)

notes.title: Monster Prom's first update is f*ckin’ hot!
notes.notes:
[url=http://monsterprom.pizza/updates/summer18/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062743/9d264f025c4fbf146261b224f5bf544f2c56cef8.png[/img][/url]

[b]To the attention of all monster dating enthusiasts,[/b]

It’s been nearly two months since we started this hot and heavy adventure, and to show you we mean business, we’re rolling out our first update, aptly titled [b]“F*uckin’ Hot”[/b]. As the scowling scalding sun might have tipped you off, it’s a summer-themed update, filled to the brim with all sorts of surprises, perfect for a fleeting fling.

[h1][b][url=store.steampowered.com]Let’s bring the heat with the F*ckin' Hot Update![/url][/b][/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]TEMPORARY SEASONAL OUTFITS[/b] - Sun hats, Hawaiian prints and sandals for days.
    [*][b]A NEW SECRET ENDING[/b] - As decided by the twitter Bae Ballot.
    [*][b]STEAM COLLECTIBLES[/b] - Trading cards, backgrounds pics, custom emoticons, the works.
    [*][b]NEW CAFETERIA MAP AND WEEKEND EVENT SCREENS[/b] - Eye-candy FTW!
    [*][b]PHOTO GALLERY[/b] - A place to kick back, relax and enjoy your past achievements.
[/list]

We even made a trailer:
https://youtu.be/qlFQrWqWtPc
It also seems like all this romance practice is really paying off. From all the amazing art, to the adorable Fish-wife serenades, the love you've shown us has been incredible. Thanks for being awesome!

Yours truly,
- Team Monprom

notes.title: Two days until release and we found a bug
notes.notes:
[url=https://twitter.com/monsterprom/status/989208314490826753]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32062743/ec86be879ce3e9da7ed5440adfd58d1b24ffd5e5.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Hey there expecting lovers,[/b]

Seems like cold feet are only natural in prom season, but there's no easy way to say this so we'll be quick:

With a heavy heart, our team has encountered an unexpected bug with the online feature of Monster Prom. We are working relentlessly to fix it, but due to unfortunate timing, the online option might be unstable upon release or even delayed by a few days. 

Monster Prom's local multiplayer will be unaffected at launch. We wanted to be transparent about this as we near release. We're all hoping for the best but issues such as this are hard to pinpoint. Thank you for understanding and supporting us thus far!

We'll keep you updated ❤️

Sincerely,
- The Monster Prom Team
